title: 2027 Commercial & Investment Bank - Global Payments Analyst Program - Summer Internship - Dublin
description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** As a Global Payments Analyst in the Global Payments Program, you will gain hands\-on experience in the innovative landscape of global payments, learning what it takes to “make money move” and promote innovation across financial technology. title: 3D Fit Trainee
description: Because you can see how we can be better. Innovate, your way. Quality at Primark What’s a career at Primark all about? Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way. **What You’ll Get** : People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle: * 27 days of leave, pension. * Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria. **What You’ll Do as a** **3D Fit Trainee** We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities: * Support the maintenance and governance of the Global Block Library and related digital tools, ensuring fit blocks, grading standards, and seasonal information are accurate, up to date, and accessible to internal stakeholders and suppliers. * Assist with the rollout and application of Fit Expression, Length Guides, fit standards, and grading rules to help deliver a consistent customer fit experience across Womenswear, Menswear, and Childrenswear. * Develop technical knowledge of apparel grading, sizing, and fit principles, supporting accurate product fit, size progression, and adherence to best\-practice standards. * Collaborate with Buying, Design, QA teams, and the global supply base to support the adoption of digital fitting technologies and emerging product development processes. * Support fit\-focused projects through the maintenance of technical documentation, digital assets, training materials, and guidance resources, helping to build capability across stakeholders and suppliers. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analysing fit\-related feedback, supporting KPI reporting, and leveraging digital tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and product development outcomes. **What You’ll Bring** Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular: * Relevant qualification in Pattern Cutting, Garment Technology, Fashion Design, or a related discipline, with 1–2 years' experience or a graduate background in apparel product development. * Strong interest in garment fit, sizing, product development, and pattern technology, with a desire to build technical expertise across apparel categories. * Understanding of, or willingness to learn, digital product development tools such as CLO 3D, Browzwear, or similar 3D design platforms. * Basic knowledge of garment construction, manufacturing processes, and apparel grading principles, with an eagerness to develop expertise in fit and size progression. * Awareness of fabric properties and performance characteristics, with an understanding of their impact on garment fit, construction, quality, and overall product performance. Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future \- and we’re excited to develop yours. **About Primark** At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn\+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 500 stores in 20 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together. title: AI Engineer

You will work closely with senior engineers, legal professionals and business stakeholders to turn real\-world requirements into secure and reliable AI\-powered tools. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, test and maintain AI and generative AI applications. * Build solutions using large language models, AI APIs and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Create tools that support document analysis, summarisation, knowledge search and workflow automation. * Integrate AI capabilities with existing systems, databases and document\-management platforms. * Prepare, clean and structure data for use in AI applications. * Develop APIs and backend services, primarily using Python. * Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, reliability and potential bias. * Support proof\-of\-concept projects through to production deployment. * Monitor deployed solutions and troubleshoot technical issues. * Maintain clear technical documentation. * Ensure solutions meet the firm’s requirements for security, confidentiality, data protection and responsible AI use. * Keep up to date with developments in AI, machine learning and legal technology. **Skills and Experience** * 1–3 years’ experience unstructured data. * Experience using Git and modern software\-development practices. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work with non\-technical stakeholders. * A strong awareness of data privacy, information security and responsible AI principles. **Desirable Experience** * Experience with Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, AWS or another cloud platform. * Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint or document\-management systems. * Familiarity with CI/CD, Docker or cloud deployment. * Experience evaluating and monitoring AI applications. * Previous exposure to the legal, professional\-services or regulated sectors. **Education** A degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline is preferred. title: Accommodation Assistant

description: **Overview** PM Group is a leading international engineering, architecture, project and construction management firm. PM Group is committed to ensuring our hiring process is fair and accessible to all and will provide candidates with disabilities with reasonable accommodations required to participate in the recruitment process. description: Location: Timoney Dynamic Solutions Limited, IDA Technology Park, Johnstown, Navan, Co. We are experts in Vehicle Dynamics, Independent Suspension, and Axle Systems. Timoney provides complete vehicle design and manufacture solutions across construction, firefighting, vocational, defence, mining, and special\-purpose vehicle markets. Based in Navan Ireland, Timoney has been in business for over 50 years with exports to over forty countries worldwide. Our recent acquisition by Kessler \+ Co, brings enhanced manufacturing capabilities to complement our extensive experience and vehicle knowledge. Due to continued expansion, including exciting electrical and hybrid technology projects, Timoney is now looking hire an Graduate Electrical Engineer to join our team designing next generation off road hybrid electric vehicles. The Role Timoney is seeking an Graduate Electrical Engineer to work as part of our design teams on internal and client projects. title: Graduate Highways Engineer (Dublin)
description: At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Your impact Your Impact Join the Jacobs Graduate Development Program (GDP) and help shape better environments, communities and societies. Bring your passion, creativity and ambition — and together, we’ll create lasting change. What You’ll Get Our two‑year Graduate Development Program is designed to accelerate your growth as you begin your Jacobs career. Through blended learning, mentoring, progress reviews and networking, you’ll build capability across four key areas human skills, consulting skills, championing our strategy, and developing your personal passions. You’ll tailor your learning journey to your interests, career goals and technical strengths — creating a graduate experience that’s uniquely yours. Much of your development will come through real project work, supported by your manager and mentor to ensure you gain the experiences that matter most. The Graduate Development Program isn’t just a steppingstone — it’s a launchpad. You’ll gain the tools, exposure and support to unlock your potential, working on meaningful projects and collaborating with industry leaders to deliver solutions to complex challenges. **About The Opportunity** Jacobs is a market leader in the transportation sector, working with major clients like National Highways, Transport for Scotland, Manchester Airport Group, Heathrow Ltd, HS2 Ltd and the Welsh Government. From global mega\-projects like King Salman International Airport to local initiatives with councils and transport authorities, we offer opportunities to make a real impact—both worldwide and in your own community. The successful candidate will be provided with opportunities to support on delivering some of Jacobs most exciting and challenging global pursuits. You will be provided with on\-the\-job training using the latest software tools and will have exposure to various stages of schemes from initial concept through to construction. You will be expected to assist and support colleagues in the preparation of feasibility studies, scheme reports, and highway designs as part of your development to becoming a professionally qualified engineer. As a new graduate within our Highways \& Civils team you will have the opportunity to make your mark and influence the continuing growth of Jacobs The start date for this position is September 2027\. Here's what you'll need What you’ll need * Be working towards a Master’s level qualification in Civil Engineering or Civil \& Structural Engineering * A flexible, proactive mindset and motivation to drive your career forward * Adaptability and enthusiasm for learning * Permanent right to work in Ireland Selection Process * Apply Online * Solo Video Assessment * Interview Apply before 12 October 2026 to be considered in the first assessment window. Applications may still be accepted afterwards, but roles may be filled during the initial window. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees. With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well\-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs. We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here. Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles. As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role. We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. title: Graduate Junior Discretionary Trader
description: **Graduate Junior Discretionary Trader \- Dublin** We are looking for entrepreneurial and highly motivated individuals interested in gaining hands\-on trading experience through our mentorship program. As a Junior Discretionary Trader in our program, you will have customized training and daily guidance from our most profitable discretionary traders to learn the intricacies of the futures markets and how to capitalize on them. At the end of the mentorship program, you will be able to successfully capture edge while leveraging our low latency proprietary platform and trading tools. We are targeting a select few who thrive on precision, discipline, and strategic thinking. Geneva Trading is seeking individuals with an exceptional eye for detail and an unwavering commitment to excellence to join our team as Junior Discretionary Trader. If you possess the ability to stay calm under pressure, adapt to rapidly changing environments, and maintain a laser\-sharp focus, we want you. No prior trading experience is necessary—just your relentless drive to learn, your passion for mastering complex systems, and your dedication to achieving success. **The Role:** * Trade your own account within a global team of talented individual traders. * Leverage our state\-of\-the\-art technology to capitalize on market opportunities. * Identify, research, and exploit new trading opportunities. * Adopt a systematic and data\-driven approach to trading. * Contribute ideas and participate in collaborative conversations around market fundamentals and events. * Work closely with the technology team to fully utilize and enhance our electronic trading systems. **What We Offer:** * Benefit from hands\-on training, mentorship, and shadowing senior traders. Our structured training program is designed to equip you with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in futures trading. * Cutting\-edge technological infrastructure that sets us apart in the industry. * Access to high\-fidelity data resources and market analysis tools. * A world\-class proprietary electronic trading platform with unique visualization and execution edges. * A global network with co\-located servers at the exchanges, allowing us to analyze, react, and execute faster and with more accuracy than our competition. **The Ideal Candidate:** * Prior experience in a high\-pressured, competitive environment (trading, gaming, poker, athletics, etc.) * Continuous Learning: The financial markets are constantly evolving, successful traders are committed to ongoing education and staying updated with market news and trends * Attention to detail: Traders need to meticulously analyze market data, charts, and trends. This role requires a high level of focus and precision to identify patterns and make informed decisions. * Routine and Discipline: Establishing and sticking to a strict routine is crucial, this includes regular market analysis, setting trading goals, and adhering to risk management strategies. * Perseverance: The ability to persist through losses and setbacks is essential. Traders must continually refine their strategies and learn from their mistakes. * Emotional Control: Managing emotions such as fear, and greed is vital. Traders need to remain calm and composed, even in volatile market conditions * Self\-motivated **:** Possess a competitive personality and a strong drive to succeed. **This role is based in our Dublin office, where the in\-office experience for trader development, education, and mentorship programs is paramount.**

title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer
description: Location: Timoney Dynamic Solutions Limited, IDA Technology Park, Johnstown, Navan, Co. Our refrigeration team currently includes experienced qualified engineers who will provide ongoing technical support, mentoring and training. Why Consider Refrigeration with MSC? Refrigeration work at MSC is different from many traditional refrigeration roles. Our engineers primarily work on specialist laboratory and medical refrigeration equipment rather than supermarket, industrial or domestic refrigeration systems. This generally means working in clean, professional environments such as hospitals, laboratories and pharmaceutical facilities. The role also offers a more predictable working pattern than many areas of the refrigeration industry: * Predominantly Monday to Friday daytime work * No shift work * No routine overnight supermarket refrigeration work * Limited out\-of\-hours requirements * Occasional weekend cover as required * Travel throughout Ireland and Northern Ireland, with occasional overnight stays For an apprentice who has already developed a strong grounding in refrigeration and wants to broaden their experience in a specialist technical environment, this is an opportunity to take the next step while completing their apprenticeship. Duties and Responsibilities **Working Alongside Our Experienced Refrigeration Engineers, You Will** * Carry out installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of refrigeration equipment. * Complete routine preventive maintenance and service work on laboratory and medical refrigeration equipment. * Diagnose refrigeration, electrical and control\-related faults. * Assist with commissioning and testing of new equipment. * Travel to customer sites throughout Ireland and Northern Ireland. * Work directly with customers in hospitals, laboratories, pharmaceutical facilities and other regulated environments. * Develop your knowledge of specialist laboratory refrigeration and associated control systems. * Troubleshoot equipment software and controls and carry out firmware updates where required. * Complete service documentation and reports accurately and to a high standard. * Provide technical support and basic equipment training to customers as your knowledge and experience develop. * Work with the wider MSC Service and Sales teams to identify opportunities to support customers with replacement equipment, upgrades and additional services. Training and Development MSC will support the successful candidate in continuing and completing their refrigeration and air conditioning apprenticeship. In addition to their formal apprenticeship training, the successful candidate will receive: * Hands\-on mentoring from experienced refrigeration engineers. * Training on specialist laboratory and medical refrigeration equipment. * Exposure to a wide variety of equipment, manufacturers and technologies. * Opportunities to attend relevant manufacturer training, workshops and technical courses. * Increasing responsibility and independence as their skills and experience develop. * The opportunity to build a long\-term career within MSC's growing technical service team. **Requirements** Essential * Currently undertaking a recognised Refrigeration and Air Conditioning apprenticeship, with candidates in the later stages of their apprenticeship particularly encouraged to apply. * Previous practical experience carrying out refrigeration service, maintenance or installation work. * Full clean EU driving licence. * Good understanding of refrigeration systems and fault\-finding principles. * Strong practical and problem\-solving skills. * Good communication skills and a professional approach when working on customer sites. * Ability to work both independently and as part of a technical team. * Willingness to travel throughout Ireland and Northern Ireland, including occasional overnight stays. * Attention to detail and a commitment to completing work and documentation to a high standard.

We are a sister company of Motor Distributors Limited, the exclusive importer and distributor of BYD \& XPENG in Ireland. We wish to recruit a **salesperson** for our location in MSL South Dublin, Deansgrange. This can be with or without previous Sales experience. We offer an exciting career in the electric mobility field. BYD is a market leader across all ranges – passenger cars, trucks and buses. As our colleague, you will make an enormously positive and personal impact on the planet and climate sustainability. The BYD brand has an incredible story to tell and is one of the most exciting brands to arrive in Ireland to lead the way in the future of electric motoring. XPENG are unique pioneers in intelligent mobility with a deep commitment to innovative engineering at the core of our company. What sets us apart is our relentless drive to unlock the full potential of mobility, whether on the road or in the air. We remain relevant because our mobility solutions are crafted to simplify and enhance your life. **Key Duties And Responsibilities To Include** * Become a product Genius by building and developing a robust product knowledge of the BYD \& Xpeng brands whilst keeping up to date of changes or amendments to the current product line up. * Achieving maximum profitability on the sales of our new range of BYD \& XPENG vehicles, promoting finance, insurance and auxiliary products. * Providing exceptional customer service throughout the sales process so all customer expectations are met, if not exceeded. * Building a strong rapport with customers visiting the dealership and proactively seeking new opportunities for the business outside the showroom environment. * Implement the MSL sales process consistently. * Achieving new volume and model mix targets set each year by the company. * Achieving used car targets set each year. * Achieving targets for outbound calls to prospective customers daily, weekly, monthly. * Achieving Accessories targets set. * Achieving all relevant KPI’s in line with the company’s commission structure. **The Successful Candidate Will Ideally** * Be proactive and target orientated. * Excel at understanding, anticipating and meeting customer needs. * Exhibit excellent communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills. * Have strong organisational and planning skills, with excellent attention to detail. * Possess good administrative and IT skills. * Work well as part of a team. * Hold a full, valid and current driving licence. If you meet the above criteria and are interested in being considered for this position, please submit a cover letter outlining your availability and salary expectation, together with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae.

title: Screening Analyst
description: **About Albany Beck** Albany Beck is an award\-winning consultancy specialising in Technology, Risk and Compliance primarily within Financial Services. We work with top tier Investment Banks, Asset Management firms, Hedge Funds and FinTechs. **Client Deployment Role Description** Albany Beck is seeking Junior Screening Analysts to support a critical Financial Crime remediation programme with a leading organisation in Ireland. The client has identified a screening issue which has resulted in a significant backlog of alerts requiring investigation and resolution. As part of a focused remediation initiative, successful candidates will support the review and clearance of screening alerts across sanctions, Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and adverse media screening. This is an excellent opportunity for analysts with approximately 1\+ years of screening experience to gain exposure to a large\-scale remediation programme while working alongside an established Financial Crime team. The initial engagement will be for three months, with the potential for extension depending on programme progress and business requirements. **Key Responsibilities** * Review and investigate sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening alerts. * Analyse customer information against watchlist data to assess potential matches. * Determine whether alerts represent genuine matches or false positives. * Document clear and concise rationale for screening decisions. * Escalate potential positive matches in accordance with established procedures. * Conduct additional research and gather supporting information where required. * Maintain accurate records of all investigations and outcomes. * Support the timely reduction of the client’s screening alert backlog. * Ensure all work is completed in line with regulatory and internal policy requirements. * Collaborate closely with Financial Crime, Compliance and Operations stakeholders. **Key Skills \& Experience** * Experience working within Financial Crime, AML or Compliance functions. * Approximately 1\+ years of hands\-on screening experience. * Practical knowledge of: * Sanctions Screening * PEP Screening * Adverse Media Screening * Experience investigating alerts and documenting outcomes. * Strong analytical and investigative skills. * Excellent attention to detail and decision\-making ability. * Strong written communication and case documentation skills. * Ability to work efficiently within a structured process\-driven environment. * Comfortable working with Excel\-based case management and reporting data. **Desirable Experience** * Experience within retail banking, payments, fintech or regulated financial services environments. * Exposure to AML, KYC, CDD or EDD processes. * Experience supporting remediation, lookback or backlog\-clearing exercises. * Knowledge of financial crime regulations and screening best practices. * Previous experience working on high\-volume alert review activities.

title: Seasonal Sales & Operations Assistant

title: Shift Maintenance Engineer
description: **Job Description** The role involves hands on maintenance activities and supports safe and compliant delivery of all engineering activities in accordance with company policies, standards, and regulatory requirements. The Maintenance Engineer supports with technical diagnosis, operational continuity, and maintains high standards of performance, safety, and customer service. This role operates on a rotating day and night shift pattern and reports to the Maintenance Team Leader. **Responsibilities** **Engineering Operations \& Maintenance** * Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems, including generators, fire alarms, and suppression systems etc. to ensure continuous operation. * Perform hands\-on maintenance activities, inspections, and site walkthroughs to ensure good equipment condition and operational performance. * Monitor and respond to incidents, faults, or alarms using BMS, PMS, CMS, and other operational systems to support investigations. * Deliver planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance in line with site schedules. * Implement and adhere to the Permit to Work (PTW) and change management processes for all maintenance and critical works on shift. Ensure Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) are reviewed and applied. * Act as an Authorised Person (AP) (where applicable) for electrical switching activities * Ensure accurate operational records, including CMMS/CAFM data, incident reports, asset registers, maintenance logs, and service documentation. * Support alarm management, alarm clean\-ups, and extraction of historical data. * Operate as a first responder during critical incidents, supporting fault diagnosis, isolation, escalation, and restoration. * Assist in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implementation of corrective and preventative actions to reduce repeat failures. * Maintain tools, equipment, and assets in operational condition, including asset tracking and critical spares. * Support customer smart\-hands requests as required. **Safety, Compliance \& Procedures** * Ensure all activities comply with HSE legislation, local regulations, and company policies. * Maintain a strong health and safety culture across the site. * Utilise monitoring systems (BMS, PMS, CMS) to support effective fault response, performance monitoring, and operational decision\-making. * Be fully conversant with company policies, operating and emergency procedures, and initiate improvements to minimise risk and promote best practice. **Incident \& Customer Management** * Active team member for first\-line response to site incidents, alarms, and system failures, including fault diagnosis, isolation, escalation, and restoration activities. * Support incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA), implementing corrective and preventative actions to reduce repeat failures. * Work closely with site teams and stakeholders on incident activities to ensure clear communication and service continuity to relevant end users. * Conduct site walkthroughs to maintain system performance and operational readiness. Raise concerns immediately for rectification action. **Qualifications** **Core Skills** (Required) * Strong written and verbal communication skills across diverse stakeholder groups. * Collaborative approach to deliver team and operational objectives. * Strong problem\-solving capability and continuous improvement mindset. * Continuous improvement focus, to enhance personal and team performance. * Promote a safe working culture and ensure all works are conducted with safety as a priority. **Qualifications** * Recognised technical qualification in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (e.g, NVQ Level, City \& Guilds, BTEC, or equivalent). * Authorised Person / AP12 / AP15 or equivalent (Electrical) certification, or demonstrable experience operating as an AP under a formal Safety Rules system. * IT literate, including MS Office, CMMS/CAFM systems. **Experience** (Desired) * Experience in maintenance of electrical/mechanical/HVAC systems. * Experience working in critical environments (data centre, hospital, pharmaceutical, utilities, or similar). * Experience operating in customer\-facing roles and resolving technical problems in high\-pressure environments. * Understanding of safe systems of work and able to evidence the implementation of these in previous roles (PTW, RAMS, Change Management etc.). * Knowledge of BMS, PPM, CAFM, and Change Management processes. * Knowledge of and experience working to international HSE standards. * Knowledge of safe electrical and mechanical practices in line with regulatory standards. * Experience maintaining HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, low/medium voltage electrical systems, UPS, generators, and associated plant. * Strong troubleshooting and repair experience of critical building infrastructures. * Competence following documented procedures and maintaining accurate records in a Service Desk/CMMS system. **Note:** The successful candidate will be required to complete pre\-employment screening to BS7858:2019, or national equivalent. (Covers: Confirmation of identity, legal right to work, financial probity, criminal history and associations with proscribed organisations). title: Shop Assistant

Our commitment to high quality products, innovation and excellent customer service has earned us an enviable reputation and continued growth. Our growth throughout the nineties and into the new millennium, coupled with recordbreaking sales, has made Wurth Ireland a top 1000 company in the country and market leader in its field. Offering a range of over 8,000 industrial products direct from the logistics centre in Limerick coupled and a further 120,000 articles through direct shipment from Germany, we are not only ready to supply and service our customers today, but for the future. In line with our OmniChannel Strategy our company expansion has led to the opening of 22 Trade Outlets throughout Ireland with further expansion planned over the next 3 years. Our EBusiness continues to expand, incorporating vending technology, scanners, online sales and selling, coupled with social and video marketing. We have the largest Salesforce in Ireland with over 90 directly employed Sales Representatives on the road selling, servicing, and supporting our growing customer base. Our main industry sectors are: Automotive Aftermarket, Engineering \& MRO, Construction, Renewables as well as Kitchens, Bedrooms \& Bathrooms. Within our company's headquarters in Limerick, you will find over 70 support staff working across a variety of functions including Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Services, Purchasing, Human Resources and Logistics. **We are now looking to recruit a Shop Assistant** who will work in our Dundalk branch in Unit 3a, TCS Retail Park, Coes Road, Dundalk, and who enjoys taking ownership of the running of all aspects of a store. The role will operate **5 days over 7 days** , including weekends, with **varied working hours that may differ from the usual Monday\-to\-Friday schedule** . The successful candidate will need to be flexible and available to work a range of shifts depending on the needs of the store. **Your Mission!** As a shop assistant, you will provide our customers with a knowledgeable, friendly, and dependable service. You'll have a passion for driving shop sales, promoting our products and services, and delivering professional customer service. You will take pride in your store, work closely with the Branch Team in general, and have lots of fun along the way! **Duties \& Responsibilities** Building effective relationships with customers through value added selling. Identifying sales opportunities and offering advice and solutions on our extensive range of products. Striving to achieve monthly key performance indicators including sales \& margin targets. Maintaining a clean shop and effectively merchandised counter area. Ensuring stock levels are maintained. Making telesales calls to new or existing customers. Keeping your working environment tidy and safe. Being security conscious at all times. **Skills, Experience \& Requirements** Experienced in selling with a strong ambition to succeed. People person with exceptional demonstrated customer service qualities and a positive can do attitude. Prepared to work hard and embrace learning opportunities. A great communicator who loves to help people. Friendly, reliable, honest and enthusiastic. Background in construction, tools or automotive industry ideal but not essential Or D.I.Y. store or trade/retail store experience. **What We Offer** Joining Wurth Ireland means joining a growing German Multinational\- full of support and opportunity including excellent training and ongoing development to help you be the best you can be!!!! We offer a competitive salary with ample opportunity to increase your earnings through monthly and quarterly incentives. Life Cover 24 days annual leave Onboarding Programme Paid Sick Leave Scheme Employee Referral Scheme Staff Discount Long Service Rewards Career Progression Opportunities Wellness initiatives including 24/7 access to Employee Assistance Programme OTE Earnings €36,744 plus pa **Diversity is our Future** *The future needs good decisions and good decisions are a result of a diversity of opinions and perspectives!* *Wurth Ireland is committed to championing an inclusive and diverse workforce that reflects modern Ireland and the people we serve. We strive to create a culture where all staff have equal access to opportunity and feel comfortable and confident to be themselves at work.*

title: Software Developer Graduate: September 2027 Dublin
description: **Overview** **Susquehanna is seeking talented graduates to join their growing Dublin office in September 2027\.** As a Software Development Graduate at Susquehanna, you will be working with senior technologists from the beginning of your programme who will act as your mentors throughout. Your role will allow you to get involved with the development teams building cutting\-edge technologies. You will be working with Software Developers who have a constant focus on evolving a stable, scalable, optimized environment with minimized risk. Our growing team of analysts, developers, infrastructure engineers and support specialists design, deliver and optimize industry leading technical solutions that can process large amounts of data, ensuring high performance and stability. **What We're Looking For** **Technical:** You have strong software development skills in any object\-oriented language (we use C\#, C\+\+ \& Python mostly). You also understand algorithms, data structures, and object\-oriented design patterns. **Problem Solver** : When it comes to solving problems, you use clear and sound reasoning. Prior experience in finance or trading is not necessary. **What’s In It For You** **Education** : Our education and training is industry leading. We provide a variety of technical classes to get you up to speed on any technologies that will be needed for success in your role. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting\-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. **Interview Process** Apply \> Technical Screen \> Recruiter Interview \> Technical Interview \> Final Interview \> Offer **Note: You must be available to begin in September 2027 to qualify for this role.** Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us. *If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com. Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.*

title: Software Engineer

distributed services used across Autodesk. * Write clean, testable, maintainable code and participate in code reviews and technical design discussions. * Troubleshoot production issues and drive title: Software Engineer Graduate 2026/2027
description: **Company Description** Arista Networks pioneered data\-driven, cognitive cloud networking for large\-scale datacenter and campus environments. Arista's award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds from 10 to 400 gigabits per second, redefine scalability, agility and resilience. Arista has shipped more than 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Committed to open standards, Arista is a founding member of the 25/50G consortium. Arista Networks products are available worldwide directly and through partners. **Job Description** **Who You'll Work With** Arista Networks is looking for Graduate Engineers interested in learning world leading product development in C/C\+\+, Go, Java, and other languages. Join us at Arista Networks advancing the Software Defined Networking (SDN) revolution. **What You’ll Do** * Writing Linux user space and kernel code to allow 32\-bit drivers to DMA 64\-bit virtual memory spaces using both Intel and AMD IOMMU controller. * Working on the hardware/software boundary for chips and the kernel. Where an x86 chip might have tens of registers, you will routinely work on ASICs with thousands of registers, tables, and special TCAM memories. You will program networking chips to provide latency analysis and keep accurate counts of events happening billions of times per second. You will write Python to bootstrap new hardware. You will build software agents that mediate and translate between the requirements of switching ASICs, high capacity custom FPGAs, media adapters, and PCIe bridges. You might tune lasers and measure and correct error rates measured in parts per billion. * Implementing communications protocols between routers and switches at layer 2 (such as LLDP, 802\.1x, BFD, etc), and layer 3 (such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS). * Updating the forwarding state of the hardware, using platform\-independent abstractions. * Reconciling the linux kernel routing model with the switch's forwarding state. * Implementing a policy language used for filtering and manipulating routing data received and advertised to peers * Accessing ASIC registers over SPI bus, SMbus, PCIe and I2C, to implement high resolution timers (sub\-100ns accuracy) and read ASIC hardware specifications to gather near\-real\-time information on large numbers of packet flows and to generate network congestion statistics. * Developing configuration management services using Go and Python to support YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF and RESTCONF over gRPC, ssh and ssl for standardised switch configuration, combined with tools such as git, gerrit, Jenkins, Slack and Trello. * Developing routing protocol agents (for BGP, OSPF, ISIS) in C/C\+\+ within a Fedora Linux embedded environment. Coding of fault\-tolerant, concurrent agents capable of handling the demands of future data centres where high performance and high availability are basic requirements. Fully automated, developer owned, Python based, continuous test harness with 100s of devices under test at any one moment. **Qualifications** * Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related fields (Bachelor’s, Master’s, PhD) * Any of the following:\- C, C\+\+, Java, Python, Go, react.js, redux.js, node.js Networking, Linux Embedded Systems, Algorithms, Programming, Software Development. * Strong analytical skills * Ability to communicate effectively in a collaborative and highly technical team environment * Intellectual curiosity and passion for solving challenging problems using technology **Additional Information** The working hours will be agreed in advance with the team manager.
